evidenceRootPolicy: Caller must explicitly override when the recorded local hint is absent; every referenced image is re-hashed before visual audit.

spatialPolicies.rule: Connected components include both primary and auxiliary historical ancestry. A scout component is spatially novel only when it has no ancestry edge and no bidirectional trajectory-overlap edge to any consumed historical component. Conservative sensitivity additionally joins near starts.

visualPolicy.representation: clean ultrasound converted to grayscale, bilinear resize to 128x128, values in [0,1]
visualPolicy.rendererNoiseSource: G2-R3-A2 already-consumed repeat-render per-case summaries; locked/confirmation images are never opened by R5
visualPolicy.rule: Image-hash uniqueness never establishes novelty. A credible scout component needs at least one clean image whose minimum RMS distance to every indexed historical image is strictly above the frozen renderer-noise cutoff. Credible components counted together must also have representative images separated pairwise above that cutoff.
